observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Canon PIXMA G3411 printer.
The box text identifies it as a 'Refillable Ink Tank Wireless All-in-One'.
Yields of 12,000 pages for black and 7,000 pages for color are printed on the box.
The actual printer is not visible in the photo, only the packaging.
A watermark 'BLESSED STAN PAUL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is present.
The background contains other boxes, suggesting a retail or warehouse setting.

claims.claim: Canon ink tank printer pixma G3411

claims.evidence: The seller's text is incomplete; the box shows 7,000 pages for color.

risks.risk: The printer itself is not shown and may be missing from the box.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer outside of the box.

risks.risk: The print heads may be clogged, dried out, or electronically faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the printer performing a nozzle check or printing a test page.

risks.risk: The integrated ink tanks may be empty or contain low-quality third-party ink.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front of the printer showing the ink levels in the tanks.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual printer outside of the box.
Video of the printer producing a nozzle check or test print.
Photo of the ink tanks showing current levels.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the retail packaging. It is priced at its worst case (empty box or non-functional unit) until the actual item is verified.
